title: Tiny, cute wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- watch strap top -->
  <rect x='41' y='8' width='18' height='24' rx='6' fill='#e05c5c'/>
  <!-- strap buckle holes top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='1.5' fill='#f7a1a1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='19' r='1.5' fill='#f7a1a1'/>
  <!-- strap bottom -->
  <rect x='41' y='68' width='18' height='24' rx='6' fill='#e05c5c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='81' r='1.5' fill='#f7a1a1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='87' r='1.5' fill='#f7a1a1'/>
  <!-- buckle -->
  <rect x='42' y='66' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#f0b040'/>
  <rect x='46' y='67.5' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e05c5c'/>
  <!-- watch case outer -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='24' fill='#f0b040'/>
  <!-- watch case inner rim -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='20' fill='#ffd97a'/>
  <!-- watch face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='17' fill='#fffbe6'/>
  <!-- hour markers -->
  <rect x='49' y='35' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#e05c5c'/>
  <rect x='49' y='61' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#e05c5c'/>
  <rect x='35' y='49' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e05c5c'/>
  <rect x='61' y='49' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e05c5c'/>
  <!-- hour hand -->
  <rect x='49' y='41' width='2' height='10' rx='1' fill='#2a4b8d'/>
  <!-- minute hand -->
  <rect x='49' y='37' width='2' height='14' rx='1' fill='#3a6fd8' transform='rotate(75 50 50)'/>
  <!-- center pin -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#e05c5c'/>
  <!-- crown -->
  <rect x='73' y='47' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f0b040'/>
  <!-- small heart decoration on strap -->
  <path d='M50 27 C47 24, 43 26, 45 30 L50 34 L55 30 C57 26, 53 24, 50 27 Z' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
</svg>
